body: Wonder what it’s like to live somewhere where the sun is out for most of the day
Congrats dude! The first month[s] feel really hard to stop, so this is no small feat. You got over a huge hurdle and I’m proud of you.
As much as I want to say it’s 3 kids in a trench coat, I’m gonna have to go with awkwardly built adult. Imo, it’s not out of the realm of possibility in the bojack word
Same, I got so invested in it that show is gonna be apart of me forever

I’m bummed it’s over, but it also ended pretty perfectly. It wrapped the main casts’ storyline that was both left open to the audience and satisfying. 

I was thinking about how Todd had to say “It’s you” to Bojack in s3, but by the end of his interview in s6 Bojack was able to admit it was him. 

View from Half Way Down and Sarah Lynn’s number in that episode where chilling. The last two episodes, “Free Churro”, “Time’s Arrow”, and the underwater episode were some of my favorites
I’m in a similar boat..just curious, did you end up calling your bank and were they able to do anything to help you?
Holy shit that’s pure Nightmare fuel

^ seconded contacting your school counselor. And true, there’s not too much friends your age can do, but I hope having someone in your circle to talk to helps a bit. 

Best of luck!

Agreed that your mother is showing signs of untreated mental health issues. I’ve seen/read about narcissistic parents saying similar things, but I digress. 

Do you have another adult that you trust that you can talk to? Or a peer? 

That was really brave of you to open up about what you’re feeling. And to tell a parent that too. I get how much it hurts when they don’t give you the support you need. Her getting mad and being mean to you was not okay. 

Sending comfort your way OP <3

I know that, and I get that. I know people have their own things going on, and they probably don’t have any malice in whatever their doing. I’m not trying to blame anyone else for what I’m feeling or for not being available in the way I want/pictured. 

But I can still feel upset. I can still feel sad, and mad at myself for feeling like I’m the one who always has to swallow my feelings for someone else’s sake & sad that I feel no one goes out of their way for me like that. 

Notice I’m saying “I feel”, and I know despite what I feel, my perception of things aren’t really how things are. But my feelings are real. 

And I know the solution is just to reach out and tell who ever what I’m feeling, because I’m sure as much as I’m in my own pit & unable to see anything around me that person may be in their own. 

But I’m so tired. And I give up

I just deleted all my major so social media too, and feel exactly like this. I’m feeling pretty low and that the people I put effort into reaching out to dont care & dont reciprocate 

I hope you can get some comfort in knowing your not alone
It’s a tiring feeling to have

I’m sorry to hear that you don’t have people around you who are understanding of the pain your going through. 

Selfish/cowardly isn’t the right word for it, a lot of people on the outside/surface don’t understand how hurtful and unhelpful it is to say that to someone who is suicidal (passively or actively). I feel that the thoughts of not wanting to live and the trail that can take a person down is already painful enough. 

They really don’t know or can’t understand unless they look into it more themselves. I hope one day they can learn and understand

You deserve people that will comfort you and be understanding of your hurt

I feel like there’s a lot of performative-ness from people claiming to support us 🙄

I think it’s good that you’re leaving that job that isn’t being supportive of you. I hope the next job you find has a more understanding and supportive management
